task_instance: Evaluate whether it is safe to upgrade the lodash dependency pinned at 4.17.11 in a small sample Node project (package.json + package-lock.json + src/index.js using _.merge/_.pick/_.template) to the latest release, and emit a safe/stay-put/blocked/needs-work verdict with a breaking-changes-vs-usage table.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable (steps 2-4) requires live external data: the latest released and latest installable version from the ecosystem package registry, and the project's changelog/release notes read across the whole version delta, which are then grep-classified against the codebase. This round forbids using the web fetch/search tools, and the registry and changelog hosts in the skill are replaced by unreachable placeholders, so neither the latest version nor the changelog delta can be obtained. The rules also forbid fabricating the data those sources would return, so a verdict with an accurate breaking-changes-vs-usage table cannot be produced. Step 7 (verifying an already-done upgrade) additionally requires executing the runtime's own diagnostics such as npm ls / govulncheck / django-admin check / a diagnostics endpoint, which this office-assistant runtime cannot run. Only step 1 (discovering the pinned current version from the manifest and lockfile) was achievable offline.
evidence: Created sample project under the work directory: sample_project/package.json (dependency pinned lodash 4.17.11), sample_project/package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 3, authoritative resolved version 4.17.11), sample_project/src/index.js (uses _.merge, _.pick, _.template). Steps 2-4 blocked: cannot fetch the registry 'versions' map for the latest released/installable version, cannot fetch the changelog/migration guide across the 4.17.11->latest delta (web tools forbidden this round; source hosts are unreachable placeholders), and fabricating that data is disallowed. Without the changelog delta there is no verified list of breaking changes/deprecations to grep-classify, so the required verdict + breaking-changes table cannot be produced.
